parsed.scene_description: The image shows a large warehouse with multiple metal cages and pallets. The cages are stacked on top of each other and appear to be made of metal wire mesh. In the center of the image, there is a red and blue metal cage with a white label on it. The cage is located in the middle of the warehouse and is surrounded by other metal cages. On the right side of the cage, there are stacks of cardboard boxes and other items. The warehouse appears to be well-stocked with various tools and equipment. The floor is made of concrete and the walls are painted white.
